scenarios.detection: Deep health reports database unavailable; API writes fail closed.
scenarios.recovery: Restore PostgreSQL, wait for health, and rerun the read/write smoke probe.
scenarios.dataSafety: Never delete or recreate the named database volume.
scenarios.externalRequirements: Native service-manager recovery must be recorded externally; no native command is run.

commands.stdout:
name: archive-gameday-msd1o8m3
services:
  laravel:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker
    command:
      - nginx
      - -g
      - daemon off;
    depends_on:
      laravel-fpm:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - -f
        - http:[REDACTED_PATH]
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      archive: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: '33:33'
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: laravel_next_storage
        target: [REDACTED_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_PATH]
        bind: {}
  laravel-fpm:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - chown -R www-data:www-data [REDACTED_PATH] [REDACTED_PATH] && php artisan
        archive:migrate-safe && php artisan db:seed --force && exec php-fpm
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      ADMIN_EMAIL: admin@example.com
      ADMIN_NAME: Archive Admin
      ADMIN_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      APP_DEBUG: "false"
      APP_ENV: production
      APP_KEY=[REDACTED]
      APP_URL: http://localhost:8000
      ARCHIVE_SECURE_COOKIES: "false"
      CACHE_STORE: redis
      DB_CONNECTION: pgsql
      DB_DATABASE: archive
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_USERNAME: archive
      HF_TOKEN=[REDACTED]
      LOG_CHANNEL: stderr_json
      MEDIA_PROCESSOR: real
      OCR_SERVICE_URL: http://ocr:8788
      QUEUE_CONNECTION: redis
      REDIS_CLIENT: phpredis
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      SESSION_DRIVER: database
      WHISPER_BINARY: whisper-ctranslate2
      WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE: int8
      WHISPER_DEVICE: cpu
      WHISPER_DIARIZE: "false"
      WHISPER_LANGUAGE: ar
      WHISPER_MODEL: large-v3
      WHISPER_OUTPUT_FORMAT: vtt
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - bash -c 'exec 3<>[REDACTED_PATH]'
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      archive: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: laravel_next_storage
        target: [REDACTED_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_PATH]
        bind: {}
  laravel-reverb:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker
    command:
      - php
      - artisan
      - reverb:start
      - --host=0.0.0.0
      - --port=8080
    depends_on:
      laravel-fpm:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      APP_DEBUG: "false"
      APP_ENV: production
      APP_KEY=[REDACTED]
      ARCHIVE_SECURE_COOKIES: "false"
      BROADCAST_CONNECTION: reverb
      CACHE_STORE: redis
      DB_CONNECTION: pgsql
      DB_DATABASE: archive
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_USERNAME: archive
      LOG_CHANNEL: stderr_json
      REDIS_CLIENT: phpredis
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      REVERB_APP_ID: 13a3bf9bb3a95a09
      REVERB_APP_KEY=[REDACTED]
      REVERB_APP_SECRET=[REDACTED]
      REVERB_HOST: localhost
      REVERB_PORT: "8080"
      REVERB_SCHEME: http
      REVERB_SERVER_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      REVERB_SERVER_PORT: "8080"
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - bash -c 'exec 3<>[REDACTED_PATH]'
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    mem_limit: "1073741824"
    networks:
      archive: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 8080
        published: "8380"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
  laravel-worker:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_PATH]
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.worker
    command:
      - php
      - artisan
      - queue:work
      - --queue=default
      - --sleep=1
      - --tries=3
      - --max-jobs=1000
      - --max-time=3600
    depends_on:
      laravel-fpm:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      APP_DEBUG: "false"
      APP_ENV: production
      APP_KEY=[REDACTED]
      ARCHIVE_SECURE_COOKIES: "false"
      CACHE_STORE: redis
      DB_CONNECTION: pgsql
      DB_DATABASE: archive
      DB_HOST: postgres
      DB_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      DB_USERNAME: archive
      HF_TOKEN=[REDACTED]
      LOG_CHANNEL: stderr_json
      MEDIA_PROCESSOR: real
      OCR_SERVICE_URL: http://ocr:8788
      QUEUE_CONNECTION: redis
      REDIS_CLIENT: phpredis
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      SESSION_DRIVER: database
      WHISPER_BINARY: whisper-ctranslate2
      WHISPER_COMPUTE_TYPE: int8
      WHISPER_DEVICE: cpu
      WHISPER_DIARIZE: "false"
      WHISPER_LANGUAGE: ar
      WHISPER_MODEL: large-v3
      WHISPER_OUTPUT_FORMAT: vtt
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - tr '\0' ' ' <[REDACTED_PATH] | grep -q '[q]ueue:work'
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      archive: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: laravel_next_storage
        target: [REDACTED_PATH]
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: [REDACTED_PATH]
        target: [REDACTED_PATH]
        bind: {}
  next:
    build:
      context: [REDACTED_PATH]
      dockerfile: archive-next/Dockerfile
      args:
        ARCHIVE_API_BASE_URL: http:[REDACTED_PATH]
        NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_APP_KEY=[REDACTED]
        NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_HOST: localhost
        NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_PORT: "8080"
        NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_SCHEME: http
    depends_on:
      laravel:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      laravel-reverb:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      ARCHIVE_API_BASE_URL: http:[REDACTED_PATH]
      HOSTNAME: 0.0.0.0
      NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_APP_KEY=[REDACTED]
      NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_HOST: localhost
      NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_PORT: "8080"
      NEXT_PUBLIC_REVERB_SCHEME: http
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "3000"
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      archive: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 3000
        published: "3300"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
  postgres:
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: archive
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
      POSTGRES_USER: archive
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -U archive -d archive
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
    image: pgvector/pgvector:0.8.5-pg18@sha256:12a379b47ad65289572ea0756efc11b7c241a6662833e8af7038cd3b73d647e0
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      archive: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: laravel_next_postgres18_data
        target: [REDACTED_PATH]
        volume: {}
  redis:
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - exec redis-server --maxmemory 256mb --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru --save
        "" --requirepass "$${REDIS_PASSWORD}"
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - redis-cli -a "$${REDIS_PASSWORD}" ping | grep -q PONG
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
    image: redis:8.8.0-alpine@sha256:9d317178eceac8454a2284a9e6df2466b93c745529947f0cd42a0fa9609d7005
    logging:
      driver: local
      options:
        max-file: "5"
        max-size: 10m
    networks:
      archive: null
    restart: unless-stopped
networks:
  archive:
    name: archive-gameday-msd1o8m3_archive
    driver: bridge
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.driver.mtu: "1500"
      com.docker.network.bridge.name: br_archive
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.25.0.0/16
          gateway: 172.25.0.1
volumes:
  laravel_next_postgres18_data:
    name: archive-gameday-msd1o8m3_laravel_next_postgres18_data
  laravel_next_storage:
    name: archive-gameday-msd1o8m3_laravel_next_storage
